commands.name: decisions
commands.description: Bring the last hidden decisions back into the bar

tools.name: decisions
tools.description: Puts a row per proposed decision (label and proposal) above the user's input field, with agree / disagree and a remark field. An existing label is updated; `remove` removes decisions answered in the chat.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main

notes: types ./types/index.d.ts declares on $: nothing (no EngineInterface member)

types ./types/index.d.ts declares state: decision-bar.proposals, decision-bar.decisions, decision-bar.remarks, decision-bar.sentRemarks, decision-bar.hiddenLabels, decision-bar.lastHidden, decision-bar.collapsed, decision-bar.editing, decision-bar.answered, decision-bar.answeredRemarks, decision-bar.language, decision-bar.texts

./register.tsx hooks: session.start, command.run{command=decisions}, prompt.compose, tool.call, ui.focus{component=AbovePrompt}, prompt.edit, prompt.submit, ui.render{component=ToolGroup}, ui.render{component=ToolUse}, ui.render{component=AbovePrompt}

./register.tsx hooks on prompt.compose do not run in a plugin a person installs where an organization manages Claude Code: there, these events pass over the plugins you install, and only a plugin the organization lists in managed settings runs them

./register.tsx calls: $.command.register, $.prompt.submit (via pickOption, send), $.session.surfaces (via isVisible), $.state.get, $.state.set, $.store.get (via setLanguage), $.store.set (via setLanguage), $.tool.register, $.ui.resolve, $.ui.toast
